regional_layout: One native board with controller/head six-layer regions and a central-layer-only free neck; validate region constraints separately from KiCad global stackup.
assumptions: Permittivity and loss of exact supplier materials are not supplied by the reviewed PDFs; numerical impedance analysis must expose its chosen values and sensitivity.
Keep local high-speed reference corridors continuous and put drying openings elsewhere; fabricator must approve this compromise.
0.001 mm disagreement between the published total and rounded constituent sum is retained explicitly.
0.1 mm FR4 plus 0.05 mm adhesive support is a study choice within published ranges; bond strength, stiffness and thermal performance remain unqualified.
A 2.5 mm bend radius covers 10 times the upper 0.216 mm neck thickness from published +/-0.05 mm tolerance; repeated flexing is not qualified.
No manufacturer-specific acceptance, quote or production approval has been obtained.

implementation_updates.USB: The controller USB main pair uses F.Cu with In1/In2 copper removed below it and In3.Cu as reference; physical dielectric/copper-slot separation is 0.126 mm. The short connector-to-ESD launch uses In2.Cu. CSI remains on In2.Cu.
implementation_updates.controller_support: 10 x 10 mm support with two 4 x 2.5 mm windows for C123/C124; 0.1 mm FR4 plus 0.05 mm adhesive. The windows are an engineering support choice, not a tested stiffness claim.
